name: Change of Integration Variable for Boundary Segments
aliases: Jacobian determinant for boundary segment sampling
definition: A change of variables from boundary segment endpoints (p_S, p_D) to a surface point p_B and tangent direction ω_B to avoid silhouette detection for non-camera endpoints.
summary: This method changes boundary segment integration variables to mesh edge parameters, avoiding explicit silhouette detection by accounting for geometric distortion between visibility boundaries and surface parameterizations.
